caption:
Most owners ask for a review a week after the job. By then the customer forgets the details.

Ask the moment the job closes, while trust is highest. If they don't act on the spot, text the review link within two hours.

One follow-up text the next day. Then stop. Nagging costs more reviews than it earns.

Recency carries more ranking weight than raw review count. A steady trickle each month beats a stale wall of five-star reviews from two years ago.

Want this running automatically after every job?

rationale: Review recency increasingly outranks raw review count in local SEO best practices, and no prior post has taught the exact ask-timing window that drives it.
